# `^LS` – Label Shift

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/README.md)


Shifts all field positions to the left for compatibility with Z-130/Z-220 printer formats. Retained until power-off or new ^LS command.

Reference parameters: **a**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 296](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
